question: Was this game decided by luck or by my choices?
answer: The game was decided by luck more than by your choices. You got two back-to-back critical Make It Rain hits from Tera Fairy Gholdengo that removed Glimmora and Protosynthesis Great Tusk, and Hydreigon missed a Draco Meteor into Zamazenta on the turn it would have won; without those rolls your win chance collapses. Your Sticky Web / Custap Endeavor sequencing was sound, but the outcome hinged on those high variance rolls.
